export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'flowserve-india-controls-pvt-ltd' loaded but returned a paywall shell only: 'Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world.' — 0 shipment rows actually seen (source counter: page claims 'Shipments available for FLOWSERVE INDIA CONTROLS PVT LTD, refreshed daily', rows displayed: 0). No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code was visible.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply evidence retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender records and annual-report India splits were not accessible: web_search backend returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' on every query, and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403. No GSTIN, turnover figure or contract record seen — recorded as null, not estimated.
note: Evidence collection failed for technical reasons, not because shipments were shown to be absent — hence 'unknown', not 'none_found'. ImportKey (slug flowserve-india-controls-pvt-ltd) rendered only its subscription shell with 0 rows; volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and zaubacorp.com all returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge page; the DuckDuckGo/searx search tool was down for the whole session (connection refused), so no second-source free view could be reached. Nothing here confirms or refutes actual shipments. Two substantive flags for the analyst, both outside my evidence scope: (1) the declared HS 847130 is 'portable automatic data-processing machines' (laptops), which does not match the Flowserve group's actual line of business (industrial flow control — pumps, valves, seals, actuators); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual one and the verdict set to accepted_hs_corrected, but I could not verify the factual code from shipment records. (2) The claimed industry 'IT и электроника' likewise appears to be a mis-mapping of the HS code rather than the company's real sector. Re-run this company when the search backend is restored and a trade-data source with visible rows is reachable; do not treat this 'unknown' as a clean bill of health.
